title: Flow Nexus F1 definition mutation and recovery contract
description: Implement the fresh version-1 definition set: atomic whole-candidate replacement, visible refusal with old set intact, canonical UTF-8-hex startup filename correspondence, duplicate/full-complex validation, and uncertain mutation recovery fencing.
design: Build from the checked Ethos schema in ethos/. Keep persistence and recovery as one atomic mutation boundary; reserve an uncertain complex name until restart recovery resolves it. Do not reuse v0 Flow code.
acceptance_criteria: A valid definition set replaces the prior set atomically; malformed, duplicate, incomplete, or mismatched startup input refuses visibly and preserves the old set; a lost mutation outcome returns Uncertain and reserves the complex name through the recovery fence; definitions, Operation stand-in, and Emission Signal stand-in remain schema-generated contracts.
